message.description: What went wrong; the validation pipe sends one message per invalid field

code.description: Machine-readable reason of the error, for answers a client tells apart (the 409 of a save: a taken slug, a conflict to retry, or a record changed since its `version`). Match it instead of the message text

allOf.description: Machine-readable reason of the error, for answers a client tells apart (the 409 of a save: a taken slug, a conflict to retry, or a record changed since its `version`). Match it instead of the message text

currentVersion.description: The stored `version` of the record, sent with the code VERSION_CONFLICT

retryAfterSeconds.description: Seconds until the address may try again; missing when the global request limit answered
